messages:
Olivia Chen: Quick design review — routing policies editor. Idea: group rules into accordions by match-type (e.g., header, body, embeddings) to reduce visual noise. Also need new fallback copy for cases where all priorities are empty. Thoughts?
Mike Patel: Love collapsing groups for scan. One worry: validations hidden inside collapsed groups. We should surface group-level validation pills in the header.
Jasmin Ramos: +1 to Mike. Header should show count of errors, e.g. a red pill with '1 validation'. Keyboard nav: Enter expands, arrows move between headers.
Tom S.: UX note on drag: if groups collapse, dragging a rule across groups can be confusing. Proposal: drag handle triggers auto-open of target group after ~500ms hover so you can drop into nested spots.
Olivia Chen: Hover-to-expand is fine but can feel jumpy. Auto-open delay configurable? Copy for drop target: `Drop to place between groups`. Also what do we do when dropping creates identical priorities? validation should block and surface at header.
Leah: Accessibility nits: the inline helper 'Drop to place between groups' is 2.8:1 against bg — needs >=4.5:1. Also when validation summary changes we should use `aria-live="polite"` so screen readers announce it on save.
Jasmin Ramos: Example validation string for the summary: `validationSummary: "1 rule failed: overlapping priorities between group 'header' and 'body'"` (we should keep it short).
Mike Patel: Microcopy suggestion: change "Fallback model" label to "Secondary model (fallback)" with short tooltip: "Used when primary model is unavailable or fails checks." Makes intent clearer for non-ML folks.
Aria (design-bot): Auto-check: accordion toggles must be role="button" with `aria-expanded` and unique ids for `aria-controls`. Also add `aria-describedby` on header pointing to the validation pill for assistive tech.
Tom S.: Preview simulator feedback: current preview surface shows tokens + latency. Can we add a small 'confidence' column and a simulated-failure toggle (to exercise fallback routing)? :thumbsup:
Olivia Chen: Good call. Also add a small banner in preview: "Simulated results may differ from live traffic — cache and batching omitted".
Leah: I'll run contrast checks and update the a11y checklist. Also propose a keyboard shortcut: press `g` to jump to next group header (helps power users).
Jasmin Ramos: Small empty-state copy tweak: change CTA from "Create a new rule" to "Add your first rule" — clearer intent for onboarding flows.
Mike Patel: I'll prototype the header error pill + auto-open dropzone in the sandbox. I'll also add a non-blocking yellow warning for potential priority collisions (and red for blocking).
Olivia Chen: Thanks all. I'll update the Figma frames with: accordion states, header validation pill, drop target microcopy, preview sim toggle, and the fallback CTA copy. Can we aim to dogfood the accordion internally tomorrow? Need engineering sign-off.
Tom S.: I can take the drag/auto-open piece. Tag me when Figma is ready.
Leah: Sending a quick PR with contrast fixes and the a11y checklist later today.
Aria (design-bot): Prototype link posted: https://redwood.internal/figma/proto/routing-accordion — automated contrast scan flagged the drop-helper color.
deploy-bot: Sandbox build created for `routing-accordion-proto` — staging URL: https://staging.redwood.dev/sandbox/route-accordion (expires in 72h).
Olivia Chen: Awesome, thanks. Will follow up with a short checklist for the release notes and a few copy variants to A/B in the preview.
